_comment: mkobj.c mkcorpstat() stores gm.mkcorpstat_norevive in obj->norevive, a bit that shares oeroded2's field, so a statue it makes has oeroded2 0 like any other object. A debug-mode Valkyrie wishes for a statue trap (mk_trap_statue() calls mkcorpstat()), carries the statue off the trap, drops it and zaps a wand of striking down at it. fracture_rock() keeps the field, so the 58 rocks merge with a wished rock in invent.c mergable() and the wish reports the existing letter f.
